2610.12345.title: Overcoming Prior Barriers: Supervised Fine-Tuning under Long-Tail Distribution
2610.12345.paper_summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) adapts pretrained large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but the required concepts can receive substantially different levels of pretrained support. Frequent concepts are more likely to be well learned, whereas rare concepts may remain weakly represented. We introduce a novel notion named prior barrier to quantify how strongly the pretrained model supports competing concepts over the target concept. We observe that prior barriers follow a long-tail distribution, placing head and tail concepts at different starting points for SFT: head concepts face lower prior barriers, whereas tail concepts require additional instructions to overcome their higher prior barriers. Our theoretical analysis further derives a predictive risk bound for SFT under long-tail prior barriers, explicitly characterizing how the prior barrier and accumulated SFT evidence jointly determine predictive performance. Motivated by this prior barrier-dependent demand, we propose PASS, an adaptive SFT instruction selection method that constructs reference-derived concepts and estimates the distinguishing evidence provided by each instruction, and adaptively allocates the selection budget toward concepts that remain insufficiently covered under the current selection. In this way, PASS jointly considers which instructions can provide useful evidence and where additional supervision is needed under a limited budget. Experiments show that our method consistently outperforms seven state-of-the-art instruction selection methods on four backbone-budget settings. An ablation study further shows that PASS's adaptive allocation consistently improves over uniform allocation.
2610.12345.paper_summary_zh: 監督式微調 (SFT) 將預訓練的大型語言模型 (LLMs) 調整至下游任務，但所需的概念可能會獲得實質上不同程度的預訓練支持。頻繁的概念更有可能被良好學習，而稀有的概念可能仍然表現不佳。我們引入了一個新概念，稱為先驗障礙，以量化預訓練模型對目標概念的競爭概念的支持程度。我們觀察到先驗障礙遵循長尾分佈，將頭部和尾部概念置於 SFT 的不同起點：頭部概念面臨較低的先驗障礙，而尾部概念則需要額外的指導來克服其較高的先驗障礙。我們的理論分析進一步推導出在長尾先驗障礙下 SFT 的預測風險界限，明確描述了先驗障礙和累積的 SFT 證據如何共同決定預測性能。受到這一依賴於先驗障礙的需求的啟發，我們提出了 PASS，一種自適應的 SFT 指令選擇方法，該方法構建參考衍生概念並估算每個指令提供的區分證據，並自適應地將選擇預算分配給在當前選擇下仍然不足的概念。這樣，PASS 共同考慮哪些指令可以提供有用的證據，以及在有限預算下需要額外監督的地方。實驗表明，我們的方法在四個基礎預算設置上始終優於七種最先進的指令選擇方法。一項消融研究進一步顯示，PASS 的自適應分配始終優於均勻分配。
